scope: Source/API geometry semantics only, not execution or proof of the separately installed 4.7.2 binary contents. Verify runtime popup.is_embedded and geometry in actual run.

segments.text:
<member name="position" type="Vector2i" setter="set_position" getter="get_position" default="Vector2i(0, 0)">
			The window's position in pixels.
			If [member ProjectSettings.display/window/subwindows/embed_subwindows] is [code]false[/code], the position is in absolute screen coordinates. This typically applies to editor plugins. If the setting is [code]true[/code], the window's position is in the coordinates of its parent [Viewport].
			[b]Note:[/b] This property only works if [member initial_position] is set to [constant WINDOW_INITIAL_POSITION_ABSOLUTE].
		</member>

conclusion: Embedded popup.position is parent viewport space; nonembedded Window.position is absolute screen space, and engine uses OS screen usable rect. Old raw y684+height42 alone does not establish viewport clipping.
post_native_finding: PopupPanel::_popup_adjust_rect grows the final Window for shadow offsets after placement. Actual Panel body/Label must be transformed into parent viewport separately; v3 records Window, paper, label, root and observes 6px shadow-only overflow in four cases.
